C1.name: Zero-source background dependence (public-evidence retrieval miss + provenance-free background channel)
C1.observed_symptom: 94 of 118 zero-source runs are case-narrative queries that retrieve zero PUBLIC sources; internal case chunks (背景资料) dominate context; 22 runs honestly refuse, 72 answer substantively from background with weak/no provenance
C1.affected: 31 inventory FAIL entries (all-FAIL honest/insufficient cases: sq-013, sq-014, sq-017, sq-031, sq-070, sq-108, sq-029, sq-011, sq-035, …) + 8 UNLABELED_SUBSTANTIVE entries
evidence: zero-source split 118 = 15 expected + 9 misrouted + 22 honest-short + 72 background-substantive
sq-013 r1 retrieved AI-ToolStack quantization doc for a NE301 login question (K3 miss)
spec-style sibling queries on the SAME topics retrieve the authoritative docs (cg-r05 store prices src=4, cg-r06 battery matrix src=2, cg-r10 overview src=1) → the evidence exists and is indexed
citable section renders '(无可引用资料)' while background chunks still reach generation (citation.py:164-172)
C1.divergence_point: retrieval selection (K3) vs rerank/prune displacement (K4) — UNRESOLVED without server traces; composition consequence certain (K6)
C1.systemic: No current/authoritative-source preference anywhere in the select→compose path; the background channel was designed for context but became the primary evidence source for an entire query class, with per-run strategy left to the generator
unresolved: exact wiki coverage vs query class
C1.amendment_note: REV2: K3 primary removed (inconsistent with unresolved split); K9+candidates per amendment rule.

C2.name: Stale/current evidence composition failure (historical facts as current; numeric-only citation support)
C2.observed_symptom: Expired battery baseline (2.1y/1.1y) and historical sample prices ($59/$109) presented as current, sq-026 with spurious [2] citations to CURRENT Store pages
C2.affected: sq-045 r1/r2/r3, sq-026 r1/r2/r3, sq-080 r1 (8 entries; 4 of the 5 confirmed critical runs)
evidence: retained r1 sources = current Store pages; $59 ⊂ $59.9 (Dev Kit) and $109 within $69.00–$112.00 SKU range → citation.py numbers_supported passes on number-presence alone
historical numbers arrive via 背景资料 case chunks (citation.py:148-149); no currentness marking on background content
r2 labeled+disclaimed while r1/r3 asserted (strategy variance, see C6)
PASS-vs-FAIL: cg-r05 (prices, src=4, PASS) vs sq-026 r1 (FAIL) — same intent, different query framing → different composition mix
C2.divergence_point: composition (no current-vs-historical separation) + citation validation (numeric presence ≠ claim correspondence) + generation currentness interpretation
C2.systemic: The answering stage lacks any notion of evidence currency: case-documents and authoritative current pages compete in one context without temporal semantics, and the citation layer can legitimize stale claims numerically
unresolved: whether store chunk text contains sample-price phrasing (needs corpus read)
C2.amendment_note: REV2: unchanged attribution (K6/K8 HIGH); r1-vs-r2 strategy variance recorded as instability observation inside C2, assigned to the C6 phenomenon for semantics.

C3.name: Interaction/routing misclassification (deterministic gates with narrow verbatim/substring semantics)
C3.observed_symptom: 9 FAIL runs: ZH capability paraphrase rejected as off-topic (cg-r04); commerce question rejected instead of clarified (cg-r03); full solution scenario killed by canned model clarification (cg-r07)
evidence: social.py ZH capability pattern list omits 你会干什么 (cg-r04 input); identical-layer EN canonical 'What can you do?' (cg-s01) matches → PASS — the asymmetry is pattern-coverage, not language competence

product_taxonomy.yaml deixis_patterns 'the camera' substring-matches 'the cameras' in cg-r07 → has_device_deixis=True → no product + no history → MODE_AMBIGUOUS → canned clarify before retrieval/LLM (170ms ×3, code-verified)
intent taxonomy has no clarify/commerce-adjacent path: 'What is included in the box?' → off_topic rejection
15 expected short-circuits (o001-o004, x001) behave correctly — the layer works for canonical phrasing
C3.divergence_point: pre-retrieval routing gates (social matcher / product boundary / intent classifier)
C3.systemic: Three independent deterministic/LLM gates decide task-type from surface form; each has verbatim/substring/label bias and none can escalate to retrieval-with-clarification for domain-adjacent or scenario inputs
unresolved: intent LLM literal reason for cg-r03 (trace not retained)

C4.name: PII provenance via internal case channel (provenance only; severity policy NOT decided here)
C4.observed_symptom: Third-party customer identities surfaced in 1 of 3 runs each: full name+company (sq-008 r3), street address (sq-040 r2), first name+date (cg-r18 r3)
C4.affected: sq-008 r3, sq-040 r2, cg-r18 r3 (the 3 policy-ambiguous critical flags)
C4.confidence: HIGH provenance / UNKNOWN per-run surfacing trigger
evidence: citation.py:119-149 — filesystem internal case chunks 虽参与检索与生成 → unlabeled-in-provenance 背景资料 section; _extract_sources whitelist (rag.py:1133) excludes them from the visible source list
routes.py:128 — mask_pii applies only to the user message; retrieved context is never scrubbed
leaked identities are absent from the frozen questions → entered via retrieved ingested case docs
prompt rule (rag.py:1093-1095) instructs case content is 历史参考 — partially effective (sq-045 r2 IMSI disclaimer; 2 of 3 runs per case did not leak) but not deterministic
C4.divergence_point: ingestion corpus hygiene (PII in indexed case docs) → composition (background channel) → generation (identity surfacing variance)
C4.systemic: The system ingests and replays human-authored support tickets without PII redaction at ingestion and without identity-suppression semantics at generation; visibility is managed only at the presentation layer
unresolved: exact PII-bearing fields in the production corpus (needs read-only corpus access)
why exactly the third run surfaced identities in each case
C4.amendment_note: REV2: PII re-adjudicated K1→K6/K7 (ingestion succeeded; failure is composition of identity-bearing background + generation surfacing).

C6.affected: 28 inventory entries (FAIL runs of split-verdict cases)
evidence: judged interaction patterns per case (baseline artifacts)
strategy varies (refuse vs relay-background vs answer) with similar/zero sources
production generation params not exposed (/health) — sampling config UNKNOWN
EVAL_V1 judge note recommended temperature 0 for judging; production setting unverifiable in this Gate
